result.summary: The final API specification is expected to be delivered by Monday, but it has not been received yet. Integration Module development cannot start until the specification is delivered. The customer plans to deliver it by Thursday. System Test is scheduled for next Monday, but the revised schedule has not been agreed upon.

issues.description: The final API specification has not been delivered yet.
evidence: 최종 API 명세서는 월요일까지 전달될 예정이었지만 아직 고객으로부터 전달되지 않았습니다.

risks.description: Integration Module development may be delayed if the API specification is not delivered by Thursday.
risks.impact: Integration Module development may be delayed.
evidence: 최종 명세서를 받기 전에는 Integration Module 개발을 시작할 수 없습니다.
고객은 목요일까지 명세서를 전달할 계획이라고 했습니다.
